cloudflare.d1.rows_read.note: Workers Paid. The first 25 billion a month are free units for the whole account ("First 25 billion / month included", https://developers.cloudflare.com/d1/platform/pricing/). Read on the pricing page; Cloudflare publishes no price API, so sync cannot recheck it

cloudflare.d1.rows_written.note: Workers Paid. The first 50 million a month are free units for the whole account ("First 50 million / month included", https://developers.cloudflare.com/d1/platform/pricing/). Read on the pricing page; Cloudflare publishes no price API, so sync cannot recheck it

cloudflare.d1.storage.note: Workers Paid. The first 5 GB are free units; storage is the sum of all databases in the account ("First 5 GB included", https://developers.cloudflare.com/d1/platform/pricing/). Read on the pricing page; Cloudflare publishes no price API, so sync cannot recheck it
